description: This file defines the SugarCacheWincache class, which extends SugarCacheAbstract to implement caching using WinCache in a SuiteCRM environment. It includes methods for checking cache backend availability, setting, getting, clearing, and resetting cache entries using WinCache functions.

classes.name: SugarCacheWincache
classes.description: Class implementing cache storage using WinCache, extending the abstract SugarCacheAbstract class.

methods.name: useBackend
methods.description: Determines if the WinCache backend should be used for caching, based on function availability and configuration settings.

methods.name: _setExternal
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in WinCache with an expiration timeout.

methods.name: _getExternal
methods.description: Retrieves a value from WinCache by key, returning null if the key does not exist.

methods.name: _clearExternal
methods.description: Deletes a cache entry identified by key from WinCache.
